name: Savanna Angels Network (demo)
mandate_text: A group of angel investors backing early Kenyan startups in health, fintech and agriculture that already have a working product.

name: Rift Growth Fund (demo)
mandate_text: A venture fund for startups with revenue in fintech, climate and logistics that are ready to scale across East Africa.

name: HealthBridge Accelerator (demo)
mandate_text: A six-month programme for health startups at idea or prototype stage, with a small grant and mentoring.

name: Climate Tech Seed Programme (demo)
mandate_text: Grants for very early climate and clean-energy startups anywhere in Kenya.

name: Pwani Women in Business Grant (demo)
mandate_text: Small grants for women-owned businesses of any kind at the coast.

name: County Youth Enterprise Loan (demo)
mandate_text: Low-interest loans for youth-owned small businesses in Nairobi and Machakos.

name: Lake Basin Agri Catalyst (demo)
mandate_text: Grants for farming and agri-processing businesses around Lake Victoria.

name: SME Working Capital Loan (demo bank product)
mandate_text: A bank loan for registered small businesses that need money for stock or day-to-day costs.

name: Mtaani Starter Fund (demo)
mandate_text: Small starter loans for informal and newly started small businesses, with no registration needed.

name: Global Founders Grant Award (demo)
mandate_text: A grant award open to any founder in any sector. Applicants pay a fee to apply.
